companyFieldUpdates.description: Crosslake Fibre owns and operates long-haul subsea and terrestrial fiber systems serving carriers, hyperscalers, financial institutions and enterprises across North America and Europe. Its two named live systems span approximately 681 km: the Lake Ontario route linking Toronto, Buffalo and New York, and the CrossChannel route linking Slough and Paris. The company reports more than 25 backbone points of presence plus separate extranet reach; extranet sites are not treated as owned PoPs. Tiger Infrastructure Partners Fund II invested in December 2017 and remains the current sponsor identified by both Tiger and Crosslake. Two Fund II AIVs held a 93.26% indirect interest as of August 10, 2018, while the current ownership percentage is not publicly disclosed. No later sale or signed sponsor transfer was identified through August 19, 2026.
